en: Hey!\nI saw you in VIRIDIAN FOREST!
Hi! I like shorts!\nThey're comfy and easy to wear!\pYou should be wearing shorts, too!
Excuse me!\nYou keep looking at me, don't you?
You're a TRAINER, aren't you?\nLet's get with it right away!
That look you give me…\nIt intrigues me so!
Hey! What's wrong with you?\nYou're still not wearing shorts!
I'll battle you with the POKéMON\nI started raising.
Eek!\nDid you push me?
I always catch mushroom POKéMON\non MT. MOON.
Oh! You're that nosy kid who\neavesdropped on us!
Excuse me! Didn't I tell you that\nthis is a private conversation?\pYou shouldn't be listening in,\nyou uncouth person!
I'm trying to find something good\nthat's not a BUG POKéMON, but…
Huh?\nYou want to go with me again?
Me?\nWell, okay. I'll play this once.
Hey, long time!\nHave you gotten better?
You are good at POKéMON, but how\nis your chemistry grade?
All right!\nLet's play another game!
You need strategy to win at\nbattling.\pAre you following my advice?
I've collected many NIDORAN.\nI don't want them to evolve, but…
School is fun, but I still think\nPOKéMON are fun, too.
MEOWTH and PERSIAN are so cute,\nmeow, meow, meow!
We may look silly standing here\nlike this, but I can still battle.
I'm a rambling, gaming dude!\nI'm on a winning streak!
What's a cute, round, and fluffy\nPOKéMON?\pYou already know, don't you?
My bike's still acting up, man.
Okay, kid!\nDon't expect mercy this time!
ELI: Our twin power became even\nbetter!
ANNE: Our twin power powered up!
We're to battle again?\nThis time, you're mine!
I haven't forgotten you were with\nthose good-looking POKéMON.
I'm taking ROCK TUNNEL to go to\nLAVENDER…\pBut I keep getting stopped by\neveryone along the way…
Don't you dare patronize me today!\nWe're playing for keeps!
Bwahaha!\nGreat! I was bored again, eh!
Hahaha!\nA little toughie, as always!
I got up early every day to train\nmy POKéMON from cocoons!
Hahahaha!\nI'll win this time!
Go win, my super BUG POKéMON!
Wow, you came here again?\nMaybe you're a POKéMANIAC, too?\lWant to see my collection?
Ha-hahah-ah-ha!\nI can't stop sneezing!
Hi, kid!\nDid I show you my POKéMON?
I went out to a POKéMON GYM again.\p…But I lost as usual.
Ah!\nThis mountain air is delicious!\lIt's so good, I can't leave!
My head is starting to spin.\nI've been hiking for too long…
Win, lose, or draw!\nNow for our rematch!
Competing is the ultimate thrill.\nI still can't get enough!
You know, right?\nLet's go, but don't cheat!
Hi, there!\pBut be careful!\nI'm still laying down some cables!
I became a TRAINER a while ago.\nBut, I think I can win.
Fwahaha!\nI have never lost!\p…And if I did, I've forgotten all\nabout it!
I have never won before…\pPerhaps I am destined to remain\nthat way…
I'm the best in my class.\nI train every morning and night!
Keep your eyes out for live wires!
I raised my POKéMON carefully.\nThey should be ready by now.\lThis time, they should win, too.
Yeah!\nI got a bite, here!\lTh-this might be the real thing!
You're finally here.\nFishing is a waiting game.
Still can't find a MOON STONE…\nHave you found one?
Electricity has always been my\nspecialty.\pI don't know a thing about POKéMON\nof the sea, though.
The FISHING FOOL vs. POKéMON KID!\nAnother round, fight!
I love fishing, don't get me wrong.\nBut, I wish I had more work…\l…It's hard to give up fishing!
What's catching?\pYou'll never know unless you beat\nme!
JES: I'll win here today and\npropose to my GIA.
GIA: Hey, JES…\nI've been waiting a long time now.\pIf we win today, I'll marry you!
My bird POKéMON remember you!
I want to be the best TRAINER \nwhile I'm a kid!
Wow!\nYou got more cool BADGES!
My cutely grown POKéMON wish to\nbecome reacquainted with you.
I cleaned out my savings and\nbought more CARBOS.
I'm not going to lose this time.\nThe wind's blowing my way!
Oh, you're back?\pSure, I'll play again with you,\nsweetie.
Can't you forget that you battled\nwith me?
What're you starin' at?
I always go with bird POKéMON.\nI've dedicated myself to them.
I used TMs to teach good moves\nto my POKéMON.
My bird POKéMON should be ready\nfor battle this time.
Are you using TMs on POKéMON?\nJust holding them is useless.
Have you taught your bird POKéMON\nhow to FLY?\pYou'll be able to soar with it into\nthe sky! Give it a try.
The legend of the winged mirages…\nYou've heard it, right?
I'm really not into it, but okay.\nLet's go!
Hey!\nI remember you!\pC'mon, c'mon.\nLet's go, let's go, let's go!
You're here again, huh?\nShut up and battle.
We've been riding here because of\nthe wide-open spaces.
POKéMON battle, right?\nCool! Rumble!
KIRI: JAN, I hope we win today.
JAN: KIRI, here we go!\nLet's win for sure this time!
I'm going to keep battling with the\nPOKéMON I got in trades.
You look gentle, so I think I can\nbeat you.\pI'll give it one more go!
When I whistle, bird POKéMON\ngather around.\pThey're amazingly cute!
Hmm? My birds are shivering!\nWait, aren't you that TRAINER…
Oh, you're a little cutie!\nSo like a darling POKéMON!\lI remember you now!
I raise POKéMON for protection\nbecause I live alone.\pThat hasn't changed.
Hey, kid! C'mon!\nI got these off some loser!
Fork over all your cash when you\nlose to me, kid!
What's cool and happening?\nTrading POKéMON, of course.
Want to play with my POKéMON\nagain?
MYA: Hi, we keep meeting,\ndon't we?\pHelp me train my little brother\nagain?
RON: My sister's gotten more\npowerful…
What do you want?
Nice BIKE!\nHand it over quick!
Come out and play, little mouse.\nI'll treat you right!
Hey, wait a second!\nDon't call me and then run away!
I'm feeling hungry and mean!\nI really need a punching bag!
Hey, there!\nWe'll have ourselves a good time!
JED: Are you here to see our\nlove, which knows no bounds?
LEA: Sometimes, the intensity of\nour love scares me.
I told you, there's no getting rich\nquick in battling kids.
I'm mighty proud of my bod, kiddo.\nCome on!
You out for a stroll?
We're BIKERS!\nWe rule the roads, man!
VOLTORB's going to seriously\nelectrify you today!
I leveled up my POKéMON, but it\nabsolutely won't evolve. Why?
Gaah! I really need to exercise\nand seriously trim some flab!
Be a rebel!
Yep, that's a nice BIKE!\nHow's it handle?
Get lost, kid!\nI'm bushed!
I've been checking every grassy\narea for new POKéMON.\pBut it's not always easy…
Koorukukukoo!\nIs my birdcall getting better?
I warned you before, this is my\nturf!\pI don't want you coming around.
I'm almost warmed up to go\nout for a swim.
Wait! Slow down!\nWhat if you have a heart attack?
I love swimming!\nI guess you're the surfing type.
What's beyond the horizon?\nHave you seen?
I tried diving for POKéMON again,\nbut it was a no-go like before.
I look at the sea to forget all\nthe bad things that happened.\p…Like losing to you the last time!
You always get to ride your\nPOKéMON…\pIt looks so relaxing.\nCan I have it if I win?
Swimming's great!\nSunburns aren't!
These waters are treacherous!\nYou shouldn't come back here!
I swam here with my friends…\nI'm tired…\lMust we really battle again?
LIA: You know my brother just\nbecame a TRAINER, right?\pI want to make him better, so I\nneed your help again.
LUC: My big sis taught me all\nabout POKéMON.\pI wonder if I'm better?
The water is shallow here.\nThere are many people swimming.
Are you jealous that I'm\nvacationing on SEAFOAM?
I love floating with the fishes\nhere among the waves.
Were you on vacation, too?
Check out my physique!\pIt's even more buff than ever\nbefore!
Why are you riding a POKéMON?\nHaven't you learned to swim yet?
I rode my bird POKéMON here.
My boyfriend gave me big pearls.\nAnd, they've grown bigger!
I swam here from CINNABAR ISLAND.\nIt wasn't easy, like I said.
CINNABAR, in the west, has a LAB\nfor POKéMON.\pMy daddy works there.
You want to know if the fish are\nbiting?
I got a big haul again!\nWanna go for it once more?
The sea cleanses my body and soul!
I caught my POKéMON at sea.\nAnd that's where I train them.
Right now, I'm in another triathlon\nmeet!
Ahh!\nFeel the sun and the wind!
Hey, cut it out already.\nYou always scare away the fish!
Keep me company till I get a hit.
LIL: Huh? A battle again?\nIAN, can't you do it alone?
IAN: My sis is still a slob.\nHelp me get her into shape!
I won't lose while I'm here!
Dad took me to a great party on\nthe S.S. ANNE at VERMILION CITY.
I'm a cool guy.\nI've got a girlfriend!\pI'll show her how cool I am for\nsure this time!
Hi!\nMy boyfriend is cool!\lMy conditioning's good today!
I had this feeling…\nI knew I had to battle you again!
My friend has many cute POKéMON.\nI'm so jealous!
I just trained up on MT. MOON,\nbut I've still got gas in the tank!
A POKéMANIAC lives on the cape.\nHave you seen his collection?
You're going to see BILL again?\nFirst, we battle!
I saw your feat from the grass!
Okay!\nI'll stomp you!
You always look so busy…\nAren't you getting tired?
You really must love coming to\nNUGGET BRIDGE.
The time we battled…\pEven though I was the second in\nline, I was the best, wasn't I?

People call this the NUGGET
BRIDGE!\pYou've already beaten us, so you're
not allowed to take the challenge…\p…But, you're welcome to battle with
us again.
Lying back, rocked by the waves…\nI don't notice time slipping by…
The weather's gorgeous!\nI'll try not to spoil it.
My sunburn is starting to hurt…
The fire bird's mountain casts\na huge shadow…
I have this strong feeling that\nI can win this time!
Wait! Wait a second!\nI'm sure I've hooked a big one!
You'll help me out with my\ntraining again?
We haven't missed a single day of\ntraining yet!
Every morning, before breakfast,\nI swim around this island…\lThree times!
Dress appropriately for battle!\nLose that frivolous outfit, I said!
You know, everything tastes great\nwhen you're out in the wild.
I ate too much again, so will you\nbattle us for some exercise?
KIA: My big brother and I make\nan awesome combination!\pWe won't lose this time!
MIK: Together with KIA, we're\nafraid of nothing!\pWe'll prove it to you this time!
Are we to battle again?
From where have you come, and\nwhere are you bound?
I want to swim without my float\nring soon.
Yay, yay!\nPOKéMON!
Oh, no, didn't I tell you already?\nPlease, stay away from me!
JOY: We've gotten stronger!\nLots and lots!
MEG: You can't beat us today!
Oh, hello!\pAre you raising your POKéMON in a\ngood environment?
With these hands, I will create\nmy victory today.
Must I repeat myself?\nI'm trying to paint.\lPlease keep out of my sight!
I haven't made any progress…\nI still can't get the right angle…
Oh, you will give me another\nopportunity to match wits with you?
They're almost finished making the\npool for my POKéMON.\pYou must drop in for a visit.
I'm a good runner.\nI've gotten even faster!
I say, friend!\nLet us enjoy our time together!
I'm the eldest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS. Remember me?\pThat's right, I'm the one who loves\nbirds for their beaks!
I'm the middle kid of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pI'm the one that loves wings.\nLet's battle again!
I'm the youngest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pI love birds for their down.\nI didn't think I'd see you again!
I'm still having no luck at all.\nA battle'd be a change of pace!
Gasp… Gasp…\pI swam here from SIX ISLAND's port\nin one go again.
You always come along while I'm\nswimming.
AVA: Let's have another\ntwo-on-two marine battle today!
GEB: My big sister and I are way\ntougher than before!
…Huh?\pI envision my house, but TELEPORT\nalways brings me here!
Oh, hello.\nA pleasant breeze is blowing again.
Hehehe, I'm practicing in secret\nagain.
What, you're sick of seeing\nSWIMMERS like me?\pAww, don't be hatin'!\nBattle with me again.
Sigh…\nMy boyfriend's busy again…
Come on, tell me, where are the\nmountains around these parts?
MIU: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to play again!
MIA: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to battle again!
There appear to be many secrets\nstill unsolved in this world.
Hi, didn't we meet before?\nWhat compelled you to come back?
It's been said that there are\nmysterious stones on this island.\pHave you discovered anything since\nwe last met?
A rematch with you, so high up!
I'm pretty familiar with the land\naround these parts.
I sensed your approach.
Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.
Kyahaha!\pComing back won't change a thing.\nI'll flick you away effortlessly!
Howdy! You're a member of my\nfan club, isn't that right?
This island is too spread out…\nPatrolling the place is a drag…
I don't forgive people who abuse\nPOKéMON!
EVE: I'll team up with JON and\nbattle together again.
JON: When I'm with EVE, it feels\nlike we could never lose, not ever.
Let's have another battle.\nMy conditioning's in top form!
It doesn't matter if you happen to\nhave the strongest POKéMON…\pIt doesn't mean a thing if you don't\nknow how to use them properly!
I work to protect the environment.\nIn turn, nature protects me!
Every time we meet, you have those\nsnazzy shoes on.
You must have gotten tougher.\nLet me battle you, please!
I was given the best possible\neducation to become this strong.\pI won't lose this time.\nAbsolutely not!
LEX: My darling NYA, together\nwe will win for certain!
NYA: I won't drag down my mentor\nLEX! We're going to win!
Have you discovered anything about\nthis stone chamber?
A mystic POKéMON is said to sleep\ninside here.
My teacher is showing me how to\npaint some more.
Today, in addition to our lesson,\nwe came to see the chamber again.
